description: We're Team Marscope, a group of explorers, coders, and designers building a map for the first humans on Mars. For the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge, we created an app that brings data from multiple sources into one layered view of the Martian surface, so astronauts can locate places, plan routes, and understand the terrain ahead. Marscope turns decades of NASA's robotic exploration data into a clear guide to help them get there quickly and safely.
